name: Wisconsin
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); the Wisconsin.gov policy states Section 508-based requirements. No enacted state statute or DOA/DET WCAG standard found.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: State of Wisconsin websites and web applications (portal policy). Local governments via the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Section 508-based site requirements (text equivalents, accessible forms, scalable fonts, keyboard operation)
mobile: not addressed — the state policy is web-only.
procurement: No statewide accessibility procurement clause found.
enforcement: Wisconsin.gov customer support; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: 2023-24 bills SB 831 / AB 904 (DOA web rules based on WCAG 2.2) are reported by secondary sources; no evidence they were enacted. A DET internal standard, if any, was not found. The UW System has its own policy, out of scope here.
